edits.prior_body: A geographic coordinate system combines latitude and longitude with a reference model, so coordinates identify locations relative to a specified Earth.
edits.final_body: Geographic coordinate systems specify angular units, a prime meridian, and an Earth reference model to anchor latitude and longitude.
edits.reason: Name the inspected reference components and remove an awkward phrase.

edits.prior_body: In equal temperament, a tritone spans six semitones; its spelling can make it an augmented fourth or diminished fifth.
edits.final_body: In twelve-tone equal temperament, a tritone spans six semitones; its spelling can make it an augmented fourth or diminished fifth.
edits.reason: Make the equal-temperament assumption explicit for the six-semitone measurement.

edits.prior_body: The Eucharist is a Christian rite in which a community shares sacred bread and wine, also called the Lord’s Supper.
edits.final_body: The Eucharist, also called the Lord’s Supper, is a Christian rite in which a community shares sacred bread and wine.
edits.reason: Move the alternative rite name beside its antecedent for clarity.
